caseName: Denver & Rio Grande Railroad v. Baird
caseNameFull: Denver & Rio Grande Railroad Company v. James R. Baird
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Utah.
attorneys: Mr. Waldemar Van Cott, Mr. Edward M. Allison, Jr., and Mr. Wm. D. Riter for plaintiff in error. . Mr. Wm. H. King for defendant in error.
